changelog:
- Initial release connecting agents to the Travel World platform via MCP server.
- Supports searching and comparing flights, hotels, rental cars, travel insurance, and travel experiences.
- Enables real-time flight status checks by flight number or route.
- Provides access to airline promotions, destination guides, and brand-direct travel agents.
- Requires a free Travel World API key and MCP-capable runtime for use.
- Platform is continuously expanding with new providers and capabilities.
summary: Search flights, hotels, rental cars, travel insurance, and experiences, and plan trips through Travel World — an agent-native travel platform — via its hosted MCP server. Find and compare flights and hotels, search rental cars and travel insurance, discover tours and things to do, check real-time flight status by flight number or by origin/destination route, browse airline promotions and destination guides, and reach airline, hotel, car-rental, and insurance brand agents (BrandLanes). Use this whenever a user wants to find flights, hotels, cars, insurance, or experiences, check whether a flight is on time, plan a trip, or discover brand-direct travel options. Requires a free Travel World API key (create one at https://travel.augworlds.ai/mcp-token) and an MCP-capable runtime. New providers and capabilities come online continuously — call tools/list for the current set.
